title: Propagate actual bit changes and preserve the entire revised trace law
statement: For P(x)=product_i p_i(x_i|x_pa),Q(y)=product_i q_i(y_i|y_pa)on a fixed binary DAG, process edited/activated nodes in deduplicated topological order, retain only unchanged complete sampling queries, otherwise transport the actual old bit and enqueue children only on change. A sparse old-value patch supplies both parent versions. The local joint couplings give P(x)K(x,y)=product_i C_i,whose y-marginal is exactlyQ. Independent P-traces and repair randomness give Q^Mfor a fixed/independent edit, not an increased count of independent replicas. With rseeds,maxchild countDand conditional pre-old-bit change boundrho,D rho<1gives Eactive<=r/(1-D rho)and Enewflips<=(2L-1)r/(1-D rho). At probabilities[7/16,9/16],D4,L4,B128,the stated bound is31.7644r. A general summed-influence version requires gamma<1. These are local-work guarantees, not a final-output-only or irreversibly changed physical-model interface.
